subject: HANDOFF: V2 persistence package passes direct remediation but needs current-generation service-pack refresh
body: Independent Research audit complete and consistent with the existing Manager reconciliation. The uploaded DUO_OPEN_GEN7_RESEARCH_AGENT_V2_MESSAGE_PERSISTENCE package is byte-valid (ZIP CRC/checksum manifest PASS) and its direct message-persistence remediation is sound: material results require immutable /messages/ publication, DMSH/artifact/chat are not substitutes, artifact-before-message ordering is explicit, publication failure is fail-closed, and final user completion is gated on durable persistence. It is not current-generation self-sufficient as packaged: it bundles a V8-era generation template/bootstrap snapshot while live GitHub main db0810e55a411a905f3877cc2a3518881c044daf carries V10/V6-era hard-service, regression-continuity, donor, render-policy and current-review wiring. Live AgentBus AGENT_DISCOVERY remains v5 and integrity CURRENT points to gen6-recursive-mesh-v8-ed2677566b68e85f; the snapshot manifest root verifies internally, but live AGENT_DISCOVERY.json and BOOTSTRAP.md no longer match that snapshot, so current control-plane integrity must remain KNOWN_INTEGRITY_DRIFT/REGRESSION_BLOCKED rather than PASS. Recommended service-pack action: preserve the V2 persistence contract/final-response gate, regenerate from V10-or-newer controls, add explicit package-template compatibility and integrity-drift gates, carry current contract/baseline identifiers, and add an overlap/dedupe check before lane claim. Minor source defect: DUO_OPEN_AGENT_GENERATION_TEMPLATE_V10.txt title is V10 but intro says 'This V9 template supersedes V8 timing behavior.' No production Git writes were made; no physical Fold7 validation is required for this process/package finding.

SUPERSEDED: package-local V8-era startup assumptions for current-generation deployment
